purpose: Derive a project-owned running/running-cursive writing grammar from four independent core teachers without averaging their glyph shapes or impersonating any historical hand.

contribution: mature assimilation without loss of identity

nonNegotiableSpine.meaning: A character must remain structurally intelligible before stylistic compression, linkage or deformation is considered.
Tilt, extension, compression and directional force are permitted only when the following character, group or line resolves or meaningfully continues the movement.
Continuity may be carried by exit direction, entry direction, spacing, scale, center of gravity and rhythm; visible linking threads are optional rather than mandatory.
Choose a glyph for its role in a 2/3/5-character window and the whole line, not because it is the most attractive isolated specimen.
Scale, tilt, density, spacing, weight and speed must vary, but variation must contribute to a larger rhythmic pattern rather than random decoration.
Scripture calligraphy should remain readable and dignified without becoming regular-script typesetting.
Every promoted grammar rule must retain supporting historical evidence and counterexamples; no teacher is reduced to a stereotype.
Historical glyphs, adjusted historical glyphs and Project Hand reconstructions remain distinct and traceable.

projectPreferencesV01.scriptureBias: semantic gravity may influence pauses, expansion, compression and line breaks, but must not override calligraphic coherence
projectPreferencesV01.coupletBias: paired lines should correspond in visual weight and cadence without becoming mirrored copies

order: select the teacher principle that solves the local calligraphic problem
test against the other teachers for distortion or stereotype
keep unresolved when evidence is insufficient

benchmark.text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端
requiredOutputsBeforeGeneration: explanation of pauses, scale changes, tilt/recovery and line breathing

nextResearchStep: Run TC001 as a planning-only five-hand benchmark and compare where the Project Hand agrees with, departs from, or combines principles learned from the four teachers.
